about: Example of personal overrides for Morning Mist: a few Visual Studio Fonts and Colors customisations and a coloured selected tab. Overrides suit the family they were made for, so build just that one: copy to personal/overrides.json, edit, and run python tools/build.py --plugin MorningMist --overrides personal/overrides.json. Each entry is laid over the stock map; a value of null removes an entry. The build still checks every colour's contrast.

EditorTabs.underlinedTabBackground.element: Selected document tab, fill: a project tab colour from Visual Studio at about 21 % over white

Tree.selectionBackground.element: Selected row in a focused tree; Rider has no key for a row outline, so only the fill is set
